meta.privacy: canonical IDs and public team aliases only; provider account IDs omitted

methodology.decisionWindow: Three completed weeks before the transaction; no future outcomes.
knownLimitations: 2025 has no archived transaction-time projection, injury, role, or free-agent-pool snapshots.
Grades are deterministic explanatory heuristics and are not calibrated probabilities.
Trade outcome value emphasizes realized production for the receiving Tatnall team.
methodology.matterDefinition: At least two Tatnall starts or 30 official starter points after acquisition.
methodology.multiAddPolicy: Decision probability is the mean player heuristic; its band and score are derived from that published mean. Outcome score is the mean player outcome score, while starts, points, surplus, and rostered player-weeks describe the full package.
methodology.outcomeWindow: Transaction week through the final archived scoring week.
